info.name: Student Advisory Backend — Release 0.4.0
info.description: All 102 current backend operations, generated from backend/contracts/openapi.json. Import the local environment and read postman/README.md. Run only 00 Smoke for a sequential check; the reference folders require deliberate role, target and revision selection. Cookie sessions; no bearer tokens. Synthetic local data only. CSRF is fetched before mutations and tokens stay in the cookie jar or request-local variables. No operator/bootstrap, Mailpit-internal, future academic, or cloud APIs are invented.

exec: // Session IDs stay in Postman's cookie jar, never in collection/environment variables.
// Fetch on every mutation: sign-in, verification and MFA rotate the session.
throw new Error("CSRF setup failed. Check the local API and cookie jar.");
// Synthetic verification can obtain a fresh challenge without persisting it.
throw new Error("Challenge unavailable. Register or sign in as an unverified identity first.");
// Request-specific tests assert happy-path or intentionally denied status codes.
// Do not log cookies, challenges, invitation tokens, request bodies or response bodies.
